description: Port the advanced extension loading mechanisms. Upstream loader.ts 355-606. Features: loadExtensionFromFactory (load from inline factory function, 406-417), resolveExtensionEntries (resolve entry points from directory, 481-511), readPiManifest / package.json pi.extensions[] field for declaring entry points (455-497), three-tier discovery with deduplication via seen set (569-606), Mix dependency extensions (subdirectories with mix.exs treated as dependency). The basic loader in .3 covers standard file/directory discovery — this ticket covers the remaining loader surface.
title: Advanced loader: factory loading, manifest discovery, Mix deps
